description: 24.kg describes relatives gathered near Pre-trial Detention Center No.1 on 23 Dec and separately quotes police describing a protest near Correctional Institution No.21. No count or explicit family demand is given; whether these are the same public gathering is unresolved.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous reporting or organizer/relative account with simultaneous crowd size, exact site, demand to Kyrgyz state, and relation to police incident.

description: The 2 Dec taxi protest is reported by several search-result outlets, but only Azattyk's Kyrgyz-language body was reviewed. No second body or independent turnout estimate was opened; search results do not establish source independence or validate a simultaneous >50 count.
required_followup: Target-specific access check and body review of a distinct contemporaneous outlet if needed; compare attribution and lowest estimate, not merely headlines.

description: The first broad December search call executed four Kyrgyz/Russian/English queries. Its full raw tool response was not persisted before the call ended; only partial visible transcript remains, so no complete header capture/search_log line was produced. The searches were not repeated.
required_followup: Treat those four initial queries as unarchived discovery; rely only on later fully archived separate searches for reproducible coverage and never reconstruct missing result headers from snippets.

description: Searches included Kyrgyz and Russian terms and a regional query but results were noisy and skewed to Bishkek, current restrictions, and general reporting. Regional print archives and other local-language reporting were not systematically searched; LexisNexis-equivalent coverage is absent.
required_followup: Further manual search by regions/cities, labor and community sectors, and available Kyrgyz-language local outlets; keep unknown rather than infer no events.
